paper_title: Improved axion emissivity from a supernova via nucleon-nucleon bremsstrahlung
notes: SN1987A energy-loss bound on axion-nucleon coupling from improved NN bremsstrahlung emissivity. Main result: gan=gap <~ 6e-10 (complete calc), assuming gan=gap. This is a mass-independent coupling bound derived from SN cooling; the corresponding axion mass bound for KSVZ is ma <~ 15 meV. The constraint g2an+0.61g2ap+0.53gangap <~ 8.26e-19 was also given. Encoded as a near-flat horizontal line near the QCD axion mass region (~10-15 meV); could alternatively be considered mass-independent. Note ambiguity between AxionNeutron and AxionProton since gan=gap assumed; paper hint and reference bound (gan<2.8e-10 from HESS) favor AxionNeutron labeling. | selector: text (sole candidate)
